Local security, Gitleaks, CodeQL, checksum, SBOM, and provenance controls
Hosted GitHub branch, Actions, vulnerability-reporting, secret, dependency, and code-scanning controls

findings.title: Independent human review is not enforced for source changes
findings.impact: A compromised or mistaken sole maintainer can submit code that passes automated checks without a second person reviewing design intent, trust boundaries, or release consequences.
findings.exploitPath: The sole write-capable administrator submits a change that satisfies automated checks but contains a human-reviewable logic or governance defect; no approving reviewer is required before merge.
evidence: Main requires strict Aggregate cross-platform evidence and JavaScript security analysis checks with admin enforcement.
Force pushes and deletions are disabled; linear history and conversation resolution are required.
Secret scanning, push protection, Dependabot security updates, vulnerability alerts, automated fixes, and private vulnerability reporting are enabled.
Actions are restricted to GitHub-owned actions, CodeQL has zero open alerts, but required pull-request reviews are unset because only one write-capable collaborator exists.
findings.resolution: Provision a distinct qualified collaborator or team, require at least one approving review, and assign CODEOWNERS to security-sensitive source; retain separately signed independent release review.
references: GitHub REST read-only repository evidence collected 2026-09-05

limitations: Commit e330d56 is present on GitHub and its Security Validation and CodeQL runs pass.
No credential was validated and no candidate value is recorded.
Hosted safeguards were changed under explicit approval; no collaborator, release, tag, signing identity, or publication was created.
A signed independent review must come from a distinct trusted reviewer; this assessment does not satisfy that release gate.
